name: spreadsheetGetColumnWidth
description: Returns the width of a column.

params.name: returnWidthInPixels
params.description: true to return the width in pixels, false for points.

rustcfml.notes: Not supported on wasm32. Does not support returnWidthInPixels; returns the width in character units (0 if no width is set). Member form: getColumnWidth(column).

examples.title: Read a column width
examples.description: Set a width, then read it back.
